# sonic-net/sonic-dash-api

Upstream repo: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-dash-api

The proto files vendored under `proto/vendor/sonic-dash-api/` are taken
verbatim from that repo. The upstream `LICENSE` file is downloaded alongside
the protos by `scripts/vendor-protos.{ps1,sh}` and placed here as `LICENSE`.

If you are reading this note in a fresh clone before running `vendor-protos`,
run that script to populate this directory.
